rules.READ_ME_FIRST: NEXAVAULT — ADDITIVE RULES TEMPLATE for the Advanced Mining & Rewards modules. The platform runs on Firebase REALTIME DATABASE (not Firestore). Merge the node rules inside `rules` INTO your existing database.rules.json — do NOT replace your existing working rules wholesale. Your existing rules for users/{balance,taskBalance,tokenBalance,...} handled in production are authoritative for those fields. The blocks below cover only the NEW nodes added by this upgrade.
rules.DEVICE_PROFILE_STAY_AS_IS: keep your existing deviceProfiles / withdrawals / tokenWithdrawals / tokenTransactions / tokenPriceHistory / events / giveaways / promoCodes / activeTasks / userTasks / vipRequests / lbRounds / lbPoints rules exactly as they are.
rules.CLIENT_WRITE_NOTE: miningHistory / miningUpgrades / dailyStreakClaims use `.write: true` at the $uid branch because the client-side transaction fallback writes records there with its own uid namespace. This is safe: records only ADD information; the reward amounts that matter are always recomputed from config and credited via server-side transactions guarded in users/{uid}. For a hardened deployment set these to `auth != null && auth.uid === $uid` and additionally delegate writes to the Cloud Functions callables, using the admin SDK (which bypasses rules).
rules.QUIZ_ANSWER_NOTE: users/$uid/quizAns is private per-user. Correct answers live in quizQuestions (read: false). quizPool is the sanitized public mirror with no `correct` field. Even a malicious client reading every public node cannot see any correct answer.
